purpose: One Coolify Raw job to materialize and validate its effective Compose; no PIT service containers may start
unverifiedPreJobField: Pre-deployment and post-deployment commands could not be rechecked after the authenticated browser session became unavailable; verify both are empty before any approval is exercised
preflightConditions: The Application remains Raw, pinned to the source commit and Compose SHA above
Auto deploy and previews are disabled; no domain, public port, router or predefined network is configured
Pre-deployment and post-deployment commands are empty
The four required PIT-only private variables are present and nonempty; values are never printed
Old PIT Service and all its containers remain stopped; its volume remains detached and preserved
Host and neighboring service health are normal immediately before the job
explicitlyPermittedSideEffects: One temporary Coolify helper container starts with access to the Docker socket and is removed after the job
Coolify clones the pinned source, writes private deployment files and may pull pinned images
Coolify records a deployment and enters startDeployPhase
Coolify creates the new Application UUID management network if absent and connects coolify-proxy to it
The exact custom start command runs docker compose config --quiet inside the helper
prohibited: docker compose up or PIT API, worker, migration or PostgreSQL service startup
Connecting coolify-proxy to pit-data or pit-rpc
Public hostname, port or Traefik router for PIT
Starting, deleting, attaching or migrating the old PIT Service or its volume
Shared proxy configuration changes, neighboring service changes, Cloudflare changes, payments, signing or blockchain writes
requiredPostJobChecks: Capture the actual generated Compose privately with mode 0600; never print secret values
Render and validate it with backend/ops/check-coolify-raw-canary.mjs and record its SHA-256
Inspect actual Docker networks, members, published ports, labels, volumes and running states
Confirm coolify-proxy is absent from pit-data and pit-rpc and no PIT service is running
Confirm old PIT volume and neighboring services are unchanged
failureResponse: Stop only new PIT Application resources if any PIT service starts or any private PIT network becomes proxy-accessible; preserve all PIT volumes; stop the campaign and report the deviation
subsequentGate: A new final manifest and separate GO PIT INTERNAL CANARY RAW authorization are required before starting PIT service containers
